## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Nalam Naturopathy & Yoga Clinic?

### What facilities does Nalam Naturopathy & Yoga Clinic have?

### Is naturopathy safe alongside my regular medication?
In most cases it can be combined with conventional treatment. Bring your current prescriptions to your first consultation so Dr. Bharani can plan your treatment safely.

### Who is Dr. Bharani?
Dr. Bharani, BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy & Yogic Science), has practised natural healing since 2008.
